trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of the 3-step proof. RECOMPUTED the Touchard-Riordan moments by exhaustive enumeration of perfect matchings of [2n] with crossing count, at the proton pin q0=1.1099785827513808: T_2..T_7 = 3.10998, 16.7236, 130.717, 1364.99, 18116.9, 295770 - every quoted value (3.11, 16.7, 131, 1365, 1.81e4, 2.96e5) is correct, and the ratios 5.38, 7.82, 10.44, 13.27, 16.33 do grow as claimed. Max crossings C(n,2) and the interleaving argument for M*={(i,n+i)} both check out; Bozejko-Speicher positivity iff -1<=q<=1 is stated correctly. Values are identical at the muon pin to 6 s.f., so the block is pin-agnostic. No trap of this category.
